assessed_groups.assessment: Four literal five-dimension lists define the same priced/reconciled vocabulary. UsageEnvelope.token_dimensions/0 derives the same list from a six-field raw envelope. Components.selected_alternative uses list order when all present alternatives are zero, and component output follows that order. Preserve order, not just set membership. A low-dependency Usage.Dimensions owner as recommended by telemetry-usage-34 is appropriate; avoid introducing a compile-time call from RelationshipRegistry back into the envelope struct it already consumes.

All three sites already call the same UsageEnvelope function and append the reported-total field. Ledger CounterPolicy tracks it, Record persists/validates it, and Aggregate.Key retains a separate token measure. This is a six-field raw observation contract, not the five billable/reconciled dimensions. A separately named raw_fields API could own the derivation; do not price reported_total as another additive dimension or delete it.

Validator and Aggregate.Key share allowed partition vocabulary. The price validator accepts atom/string known values with detailed errors, then enforces provider/component constraints. The checkpoint Key decoder accepts string enum values and permits nil partitions. Centralize vocabulary without substituting one entire validation function for another.

Validator and Aggregate.Key share duration vocabulary with different nil/input/error contracts. CodingAgent has an additional inline identical allowed list in the Claude pricing descriptor, outside the attribute census; it represents provider permission, not a mandate to accept future global vocabulary additions. ProviderDimensions narrows each component and UsageEnvelope validates supplied partitions against provider metadata. Retain those checks.

All eight attribute declarations and references inspected. Seven name module-specific ETS tables; SnapshotStore uses its module in persistent_term tuple keys. Identical source text expands to eight distinct identities. Do not centralize these values into one table/key. Shared storage mechanics would need explicit identity, ownership and retention contracts, beyond this literal match.

PriceTable.Validator and ExactMoney use the same pattern and explicit String.valid? check, but return invalid_price_currency versus invalid_currency. Inline census adds Aggregate.Key.currency/1 with the same pattern, no explicit String.valid? precheck, and bare :error. Sharing a named currency-shape predicate is possible; preserve caller validation/error contracts. No ISO currency-code membership or strict whole-input validity proved by pattern identity.

All 28 sites are @primary_key false on configuration embedded schemas; declaration contexts inspected. These are local Ecto schema declarations, not 28 independently invented product policies. Keep explicit declarations unless a broader schema construction abstraction earns its complexity. A global false constant provides no useful owner.

All 15 declarations and attribute references inspected. They refer to the same named Phoenix PubSub transport, while topics, payloads, subscribe/broadcast behavior, missing-process handling and broadcast_from usage differ. The identity is already shared; do not count each spelling as duplicated bus implementation. Event boundaries should own topics and payloads; any transport injection belongs at composition boundaries, not a universal merged event API.

Five attribute sites and a sixth inline UsageAggregate.Checkpoint bounded/1 use the same unsigned-64 ceiling. These are storage-domain bounds, not operational timeouts. Keep positive positions separate from nonnegative counters/generations and preserve error envelopes. Record.bounded_integer?/1 is already reused by CounterPolicy and Ledger.Checkpoint; a storage leaf could centralize the primitive without coupling aggregate decoding to the full ledger record implementation.
assessed_groups.caveat: RetiredFloor.write/3 checks nonnegative integers but does not apply the ceiling in its visible guard/body, while its loader does. Equality of decoder constants does not prove every writer is symmetrically bounded. Caller reachability and runtime effect of an oversized floor were not investigated; do not present a reproduced incident.

assessed_groups.assessment: Four fully-qualified calls already obtain provider families from CodingAgent. This is reuse, not four independent provider lists. assessed_groups.assessment: AgentLog truncates trimmed body summaries to 1600 String.slice units and appends an ellipsis marker. LiveConversation.Normalizer passes 1600 to Sanitizer.sanitize_projection with URL/environment redaction and delivery-dependent trimming; fragment joins add a separate byte cap. Related display policy could be named, but equal bounds do not justify replacing the sanitation pipeline with plain log truncation.

assessed_groups.assessment: BuildOrder.Bounded accepts a positive decimal identifier with at most nineteen bytes/digits. Claude telemetry also bounds input text to nineteen bytes but parses and enforces nonnegative signed-int64 maximum 9223372036854775807. Equal lexical length is not equal numeric range or zero policy.

assessed_groups.assessment: BuildOrder.Bounded limits URLs/routes to 2048 bytes with UTF-8 and URI/path checks. DecisionValidation limits optional ticket URL text to 2048 String.length units after trimming, allows nil, checks controls, and redacts secrets. Do not merge these validators or describe their limits as the same byte bound.

regex_assessments.assessment: Three sites including inline Aggregate.Key; domain error atoms differ and only two callers explicitly guard valid UTF-8. Preserve wrappers and treat any anchoring/input-policy change separately from extraction.

PriceTable.Validator.price/1 and ExactMoney.exact_decimal/1 share the decimal string grammar, valid UTF-8 check and 1..128-byte bound. ExactMoney additionally accepts bounded integers and Decimal structs, validates nonnegative/finite amounts and supports explicit minor-unit conversion; price rejects non-string inputs and floats separately. Error atoms and overlength behavior differ. Extract only shared lexical validation if worthwhile, not either whole decoder.
